# Restore By The Shore

Official website: https://restorebytheshore.co.uk/
Primary language: en-GB
Type: static informational site for Christian ministry and service respite accommodation in Penzance, Cornwall.

## Canonical URLs
- https://restorebytheshore.co.uk/

## Discovery

## Key content summary
- Purpose: offer peaceful, affordable self-catered stays for people in Christian ministry and service who need rest and renewal.
- Audience: people employed by or volunteering with Christian organisations or registered charities.
- Location context: Penzance, Cornwall, UK.
- Contact path: website enquiry form on homepage.

## Safety context
- Includes links to crisis and mental health support resources in the footer.
- In emergencies, users should contact local emergency services.
